body.title: Vessel for a simulation d0415fc497aca19f: AeratedBioreactor, stirred tank

specs.label: Plant scale
specs.gloss: the product the plant makes in a year, which with the titre at harvest sets how much broth the vessels take
specs.note: One of plant_scale and batch_volume is needed. A plant scale runs the year on the corn plant's TEA operating hours, read from biorefineries.corn.
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a plant's yearly output is above none

specs.label: Batch volume
specs.gloss: one vessel's working volume per batch: a design of one vessel, its broth fed over its cycle
specs.note: One of plant_scale and batch_volume is needed. One vessel needs a loading time: BioSTEAM sizes a single vessel's schedule with it.
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a volume is above none

specs.label: Vessel type
specs.gloss: whether the aerated vessel is a stirred tank, whose agitator BioSTEAM sizes and costs, or a bubble column, with none; it chooses the kLa correlation BioSTEAM computes with
specs.note: BioSTEAM's own name for it is design. A person's choice here is a named assumption; a request that names the vessel type (fermos_vessel's vesselType) is a convention of that request, and the two must agree. Changing it changes the kLa correlations offered and whether an agitator is costed.
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Largest vessel
specs.gloss: the largest single vessel BioSTEAM may use; it adds vessels rather than exceed it
specs.note: Give N or V_max, not both. The NREL vessel has no default of its own: BioSTEAM's anaerobic bioreactor's, as the ethanol flowsheet passes it.
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a vessel's volume is above none

specs.label: Number of vessels
specs.gloss: how many vessels share the broth; unset, BioSTEAM finds it from the largest vessel
specs.note: None by default: BioSTEAM finds the number from V_max. Give N or V_max, not both.
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a design has at least one vessel (BioSTEAM's NREL vessel refuses fewer than two, in its own words)

specs.label: Working volume fraction
specs.gloss: the share of each vessel the broth fills
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a share lies between none and the whole

specs.label: Length to diameter
specs.gloss: the vessel's height over its width
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a vessel's aspect ratio is above none

specs.label: Vessel material
specs.gloss: what the pressure vessel is made of, which sets its cost factor
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Vessel orientation
specs.gloss: whether the pressure vessel stands vertical or lies horizontal (BioSTEAM's vessel_type; the stirred tank or bubble column is the vessel type chosen beside the panel)
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Reacting time
specs.gloss: the hours each batch reacts: the simulation's harvest hour
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a batch's time is above none

specs.label: Cleaning and unloading time
specs.gloss: the hours between batches to empty and clean a vessel
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative time

specs.label: Loading time
specs.gloss: the hours to fill a vessel; unset, BioSTEAM takes each vessel to be filled all the time it is not reacting or being cleaned
specs.note: None by default: BioSTEAM assumes each vessel is constantly being filled.
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative time

specs.label: Size the air for
specs.gloss: whether the air is sized for the simulation's peak oxygen uptake or its average over the batch
specs.note: D7: the vessel must meet the culture's peak demand, so peak is the convention; batch-average is what BioSTEAM's class sizes for of itself, and the oxygen balance then shows where the peak falls short.
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Peak oxygen uptake
specs.gloss: the highest oxygen uptake rate over the simulated batch
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative uptake

specs.label: Average oxygen uptake
specs.gloss: the oxygen the simulated batch takes up, over its hours
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative uptake

specs.label: kLa correlation
specs.gloss: the correlation BioSTEAM computes the oxygen transfer coefficient with
specs.note: BioSTEAM 2.54.0 runs Riet for a stirred tank; it registers Labik, Galaction as well, which its AeratedBioreactor does not implement on this BioSTEAM, so they are not offered
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Dissolved oxygen setpoint
specs.gloss: the dissolved oxygen held in the broth, as a share of saturation
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a share lies between none and the whole

specs.label: Compressor efficiency
specs.gloss: the air compressor's isentropic efficiency
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: an efficiency lies between none and the ideal

specs.label: Agitation power per volume
specs.gloss: the agitator's power per working volume; solved, not set, while optimize_power is on
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative power

specs.label: Optimize power
specs.gloss: whether BioSTEAM solves the agitation and the air together for the least total power that meets the uptake
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Temperature
specs.gloss: the broth's temperature
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a temperature in kelvin is above none

specs.label: Pressure
specs.gloss: the vessel's operating pressure
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: an absolute pressure is above none

specs.label: Heat exchanger
specs.gloss: how the vessel's heat is removed: a recirculation loop through an exchanger, or a jacket
specs.boundsReason: a choice of words: it has no bounds

specs.label: Loop temperature change
specs.gloss: the largest change in temperature across the recirculation loop's exchanger
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative change

specs.label: Jacket annular width
specs.gloss: the width of the jacket around the vessel, when jacketed
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: a width is above none

specs.label: Air cooler pressure drop
specs.gloss: the pressure the air loses in its cooler
specs.boundsReason: a physical limit: no negative drop

specs.label: Heat per oxygen consumed
specs.gloss: a forced heat per oxygen consumed; unset, BioSTEAM computes the duty from the heats of formation in and out
specs.note: None by default: the duty from the reaction's heats of formation. Not an oxygen demand: BioSTEAM sizes the air from the reaction's oxygen.
specs.boundsReason: no bound: a heat released is negative and BioSTEAM takes any value

Each default is NRELAnaerobicBatchBioreactor's own in BioSTEAM 2.54.0, read from its code at import in the worker; a value a person types is a named assumption, and the design's basis names it.

Not offered: reactions, built from what the simulation made; Nmin, stored by the NREL vessel and never used (measured: a large flow gave more vessels); Nmax, stored by the NREL vessel and never used (measured: a large flow gave more vessels).
